content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] module [article_no] and the expansion module [product_name] [article_no]. I want to dim an LED lamp using the 0-10V output. My issue is that with my [product_name] version, it's not possible to use certain logic blocks such as 'Analog ramp'. Is there a way to operate the analog output without an analog input? Ideally, I want the light to turn on at a set time, starting at minimum intensity and gradually increasing to maximum. Thank you very much. Best regards, [user_name].
That function is not available. You need a newer version of [product_name], such as [article_no].
Currently, you can use [article_no] [product_name] with 8DI/4DO and 400 blocks. See more at [url].

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation highlights that the current [product_name] hardware version does not support advanced analog block logic required for specific applications such as ramping analog output. Users express difficulty in achieving desired control due to these hardware limitations and are advised to upgrade to a newer version for full functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to implement a time-controlled lamp dimming function using their existing [product_name] and expansion modules. Specifically, they wish to enable analog output functionality independent of analog input and utilize advanced logic blocks.
